data.notes: Strong report. It keeps the international-only scope, ties 'what's mine?' to rewriting M4 around the customer's own approvals, keeps Adyen's results unknown, and covers all four expected messaging directions. Its main weakness is the 'decided' section: it challenges 'nothing to do' with the late analysis and the renewal-notice discovery, but does not name the core finding there, which is that the account had no coverage (no business review for 9–10 months, never met Stefan). It also gives 'Support and service' as runner-up instead of the key's 'Champion or access', and invents an Adyen origin for 'local cards, local rails'.
